# Handle failed alarm snooze and dismiss writes

Snoozing or dismissing an alarm modifies the calendar item asynchronously and can fail. Catch that failure, log which item was affected, and avoid treating an uncommitted alarm change as saved.

Scope: calendar-alarms.

Paths:

- `calendar/base/src/CalAlarmService.sys.mjs`
